title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Clearwater Neurology Group under your health plan for services provided on June 17, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) treatment course is considered experimental or investigational for your condition under our medical policy. Reason code: CO-55.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $6,807.11 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Verdane Health Plan, Appeals Unit, PO Box 98683, Columbus, OH 43215. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-0500.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
